newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Jan 2.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Jan 2.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
A series of forecasters have confidently predicted a secure and buoyant economy in 1997, with more jobs a surge in high street sales and a strong climb for the property market.
BREWERS WORST IN BRITISH PAY STAKES

The least generous payers in British industry are brewers, publicans and restaurateurs with the average wage in the sector at 10,000 stg a year. However, Bass chief executive Sir Ian Prosser received 645,000 stg last year.
WALL STREET CHILL TO GIVE LONDON THE SHIVERS
Following Tuesday's mini-crash on Wall Street City dealers were today poised for a turbulent time on the markets. Shares and bonds are expected to fall sharply.
